sections.heading: About Orion Brands
sections.content:
Orion Brands is a fast-growing, US-based baby essentials company best known for its top quality modern baby nursery bedding that have satisfied and served hundreds of thousands of parents since 2016. At the center of our success is our mad obsession for serving our community of first time parents.
We are a family owned business on a mission to celebrate parenthood with our community of super moms and dads by creating beautiful and easy to use products that brings joy in their tough lives and keeps their little humans safe in utmost comfort.
We're changing how quality baby products make parenting easy and enjoyable. As one of our early hires, you will help us deliver this promise.

sections.heading: Job Description:
sections.content: We are looking for an enthusiastic and resourceful virtual assistant to join our online marketing team. As a Content and Community Manager you will be responsible for creating and posting the content for social media channels based on our guidelines. You will also manage the community and audience on all social channels.

sections.heading: Must Have Qualities:
sections.content:
You must be enthusiastic about internet marketing and have a strong desire to be a good social media manager
Smart and creative in making content
Good in graphics and copywriting
Must know how to use Canva or Adobe Photoshop
Self starter with a killer "Get Stuff Done" attitude.
A problem-solver not a problem-presenter
Good leadership skills with abilities to organise and delegate
Excellent comprehension and writing skills
Effective communication
Capability to balance logic with creativity
Excellent research and reporting skills

sections.heading: What You'll Do:
sections.content:
Create and post social media content based on our provided guidelines
Manage social and content channels including:
Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Youtube, TikTok by:
Curating and developing content as per our guidelines,
Scheduling and posting content on all social channels,
Engagement with audience
Running polls, quiz, contests
Running messenger bots, etc.
Influencer marketing on Instagram and TikTok
Managing paid advertisement on social channels

sections.heading: Salary & Benefits:
sections.content:
Work from home
Competitive pay, upto $800/month
Yearly bonus
Hands on Training
Full on support and feedback from me
A chance to grow your skills, experience and to do what you truly love doing!
Work in an amzing culture where we support and care for each other
